title: Connect dispatch-ui fleet pages to real Fleet Management API
description: Remove mock data and connect all fleet UI pages (carriers, drivers, vehicles, contacts) to the real backend API. All API client functions already use axiosInstance — this story removes any VITE_USE_MOCKS guards and mock data arrays from src/, verifies each page loads real data, and confirms error states render correctly with real server responses.
acceptanceCriteria: All VITE_USE_MOCKS checks removed from fleet feature src/ files
All mock data arrays removed from src/ (moved to __tests__/fixtures/ if needed for tests)
Carrier list page loads paginated data from GET /api/v1/carriers
Carrier detail page loads from GET /api/v1/carriers/:carrierId and onboarding status from GET /api/v1/carriers/:carrierId/onboarding
Create/edit carrier form submits to POST/PATCH and shows notistack success toast
Driver list page loads from GET /api/v1/drivers with carrierId filter working
Driver detail page loads from GET /api/v1/drivers/:driverId
Driver preferences tab saves via PATCH /api/v1/drivers/:driverId with JSON preference fields
Vehicle list page loads from GET /api/v1/vehicles (no expenses in list)
Vehicle detail page loads from GET /api/v1/vehicles/:vehicleId with full expenses array
CPM expense editor saves via PATCH /api/v1/vehicles/:vehicleId with expenses replacement
Contact list page loads from GET /api/v1/contacts
Contact detail page loads from GET /api/v1/contacts/:contactId
409 conflict responses on delete show blocking load IDs in the ConfirmDeleteDialog error state
Insurance expiry warning banner renders correctly from real carrier data
Onboarding checklist renders from real GET /carriers/:carrierId/onboarding response
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
